```{r load-data}
df <- read_csv("features_merged.csv")

cat("Dimensions:", dim(df), "\n")
cat("First 10 columns:", names(df)[1:10], "\n")
```
```{r structure}
head(df, 5)
```
```{r label-dist}
ggplot(df, aes(x = factor(label), fill = factor(label))) +
  geom_bar() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#3B8BD4", "#E8593C")) +
  labs(title = "Label distribution", x = "Label", y = "Count", fill = "Label") +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r pixel-sanity}
pixel_cols <- df |> select(-filename, -label)

cat("Min:",  min(pixel_cols),              "\n")
cat("Max:",  max(pixel_cols),              "\n")
cat("Mean:", mean(as.matrix(pixel_cols)), "\n")
cat("Std:",  sd(as.matrix(pixel_cols)),   "\n")
```
```{r color-histogram}
breaks <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 9)  # 8 bins

color_features <- df |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    r_bins = list(hist(c_across(starts_with("r_")), breaks = breaks, plot = FALSE)$counts),
    g_bins = list(hist(c_across(starts_with("g_")), breaks = breaks, plot = FALSE)$counts),
    b_bins = list(hist(c_across(starts_with("b_")), breaks = breaks, plot = FALSE)$counts)
  ) |>
  unnest_wider(r_bins, names_sep = "_") |>
  unnest_wider(g_bins, names_sep = "_") |>
  unnest_wider(b_bins, names_sep = "_") |>
  select(filename, label, starts_with("r_bins"), starts_with("g_bins"), starts_with("b_bins"))

head(color_features)
```
